# Rigby2D minimal reference-runtime subset for Crew Tree art-authoring QA

This directory contains unchanged upstream source files for a **development-only** proof of concept: it is loaded solely by `art-studies/bake.html`. The public Crew Tree game does not import it.

Upstream: https://github.com/jaisurya-dev-art/rigby2d
Pinned commit: b5d85082228acb31642c2df07543e3540574f3d9
Included runtime entrypoints: `src/core/interop.js`, `src/core/pose.js`, `src/core/state.js` and their recursive relative-import dependencies.
License: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE). No upstream artwork, demos, trademarks, or NILA / Rigbytron assets are included.
Do not claim full editor integration from this parser/animation pose probe.
